static_traits.name: Zhou Jianguo
static_traits.social_status: In the past six months growing distant from friends and family due to negative thoughts, not yet confiding feelings to friends
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems appeared in the past; has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to reflect, fairly cooperative; low mood, neutral tone

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I will never achieve anything in this life because of participating in an NFL fantasy football league. This inferiority and worthlessness began about 6 months ago, with pressure from balancing hobbies and real-life responsibilities. Almost every day when doing fantasy football or other leisure activities I feel low mood and worthlessness, accompanied by decreased drive.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these feelings of inferiority are affecting my overall mood and motivation to complete daily tasks, so I am seeking counseling for support.

core_beliefs: I have no value / not good enough

special_situations.event: After spending hours setting the fantasy football lineup, the team still lost the game last weekend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even do well at a 'game', it means I will not succeed in real life either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling lineup investment to avoid failure; repeated self-blame after matches; displacing attention with reading
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even do well at this kind of game; even less possible to do well in reality

special_situations.event: Feeling unable to juggle work, responsibilities and hobbies, increased stress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve perfect balance in all aspects, it equals total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces contact with people, compresses leisure or controls arrangements through effort to seek a 'perfect balance'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have failed in every way

special_situations.event: When doing fantasy football or other leisure activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Spending time on interests is a waste, showing I am not motivated enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to reduce or avoid leisure, distracting with reading, persistent self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not waste time on these things

special_situations.event: Considering whether to confide current inferiority and worthlessness to friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I tell friends these feelings, it will add burden to them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping silent, not seeking help, isolating from friends and family
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will bother them / they do not want to hear this

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and recognized as a valuable person, and to freely enjoy interests without being negated
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as incompetent and a failure, becoming a burden to others, and thus being belittled or distanced
defense_goal: Avoiding being judged or burdening others by not seeking help and keeping distance
Prevents the shame brought by failure through self-harshness and pursuing perfection
Rationalizing not seeking support with logical reasons, to reduce the risk of exposing vulnerability

object_relations.object_representation: People who might judge me or be dragged down by me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to seek support from friends/family or to express vulnerability more deeply in counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing needs will add burden to the other party and be seen as troublesome
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing the reasons for 'not bothering others' in an objective, emotion-downplaying tone, minimizing one's own needs, avoiding further emotional exposure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of sharing current troubles with friends or seeking comfort
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes others will find oneself troublesome or look down on oneself (attributing inner worries to others' thoughts)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using expressions guessing others' thoughts (e.g. 'they do not want to hear it'), then choosing silence or avoiding contact.

manifestations: Generalizing failure in fantasy football and other leisure as 'never achieving anything in this life'
Equates interests with 'wasting time', finding it hard to experience meaning and value in activities
Feeling conflicted and guilty between freely choosing leisure and shouldering responsibilities
Tending to measure oneself with rigid rules (should not spend time on interests)
Grows distant from friends and family due to negative thoughts
Unwilling to express needs, fearing 'bothering others'
outcomes: Reduced social support, negative emotions amplified
Worsened helplessness and sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Repeated self-denial ('I achieve nothing'), constraining oneself with strict rules
Over-worrying about burdening others when sharing needs, repressing help-seeking impulses

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Turns support that could have been sought outward into harshness and self-consumption toward oneself
Chooses silence and distance rather than contacting friends for help

positive_force: Has several project experiences at work that make oneself proud, providing evidence of ability and achievement
Having some self-regulation attempts (displacing attention through reading)
Having reachable friend resources (though not yet utilized)
Able to notice negative thinking patterns and willing to try recording and adjusting them (clear motivation to seek help)
negative_force: Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking intensifying failure feelings
Equating leisure with 'waste / should not', forming rigid value rules
Social withdrawal and not seeking help, leading to decreased support and worsening emotions
Catastrophizing self-evaluation and persistent self-blame, lowering motivation and functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Negative automatic thoughts and self-deprecation (e.g. 'I achieve nothing', 'I am not good enough')
antecedent: When doing fantasy football or other leisure activities
When feeling pressure in task/role conflict (work and hobby balance)
After losing a fantasy football game
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization of failure and black-and-white rules, equating local setbacks with overall worthlessness
target_behavior.function: In the short term, obtaining a sense of control through self-criticism and avoiding reinvesting in order to evade potential failure and being judged
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood, decreased drive, impaired work performance, reinforcing a vicious cycle of worthlessness

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal and not seeking help (avoiding contact / confiding with friends and family)
antecedent: When thinking about sharing inferiority and low mood with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying that exposing vulnerability will be judged, projecting inner anxiety as others' feelings of being burdened
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of being rejected or belittled, briefly reducing anxiety and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, worsened isolation, negative emotions persisting and worsening
